pages.extract: Bełchatów is a town in the Łódź Voivodship of Poland. It's famous for its coal mines and the largest coal fuelled thermal power plant in Europe.

pages.title: Dronten
pages.description: municipality in the Netherlands
pages.extract:
Dronten is one of the six municipalities making up the province of Flevoland in the Netherlands. It encompasses the namesake town and two villages, Swifterbant and Biddinghuizen, as well as vast expanses of agricultural fields and plains left to nature.
Like much of the rest of Flevoland, Dronten does not have a reputation as a tourist destination, but still has quite a bit to offer to diverse groups of tourists. Families with children can have a good time at Walibi Holland in Biddinghuizen, while those interested in the history of mankind will surely want to learn more of the prehistoric Swifterbant culture.

pages.title: Europa Island
pages.description: island in the Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean
pages.extract: Europa Island (French: Île Europa, pronounced ih-LEU-roh-pah) is a small atoll off East Africa, about halfway between southern Madagascar and southern Mozambique – nowhere near Europe.

pages.title: Giresun
pages.description: central district and city in Giresun Province, Turkey
pages.extract: Giresun is a city in the Eastern Karadeniz region, on the Black Sea coast of Turkey. In 2023 the population was 144,000.

pages.title: Greenfield (Massachusetts)
pages.description: city in Massachusetts, United States; county seat of Franklin County
pages.extract: Greenfield is in Franklin County, Massachusetts. It is home to Greenfield Community College.

pages.title: Johnston (Rhode Island)
pages.description: town in Providence County, Rhode Island, United States
pages.extract: Johnston is a town in Providence County, Rhode Island, United States. Johnston is very famous for its landfill.  The landfill is the only one in the state of Rhode Island and is occasionally subject to many issues such as over capacity or a strong smell.  Although the Landfill seems like it is not something you would not want to see, it is definitely a worthwhile trip.  All of the machinery used to process the disposed waste is available for viewing.  It is quite interesting to see the process that has to be done in order to get rid of the whole state of Rhode Island’s trash!

pages.title: Moustiers Sainte Marie
pages.description: commune in Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, France
pages.extract: Moustiers-Ste-Marie is a village in the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence in southern France.  It was once a major pottery centre and now serves as a gateway to the Gorges du Verdon, sometimes called the "European Grand Canyon".

pages.title: Naselle
pages.description: census designated place in Pacific County, Washington, United States
pages.extract: Naselle is a town of about 400 residents in southwest Washington State on the southwest corner of the Willapa Hills and just inland of the southeast corner of Willapa Bay, some 10 mi (16 km) east of Long Beach. Naselle sits on the Naselle River and is known for year-round sturgeon fishing.

pages.title: North Central Wisconsin
pages.extract: North Central Wisconsin is in Wisconsin. The region’s numerous lakes and forests make it a popular destination for outdoor enthusiasts during the summer season.

pages.title: Ruse
pages.description: city in Ruse municipality, Ruse oblast, Bulgaria
pages.extract: Ruse  (Bulgarian: Русе, also romanized as Rousse) is a port city on the Danube in North Bulgaria. It is the sixth largest city in Bulgaria, and one of the two main river crossings to Romania. It has a rich legacy of fin-de-siècle European architecture that calls back to the time when Ruse was one of the most developed and cosmopolitan cities in Bulgaria.

pages.title: Sakteng Wildlife Sanctuary
pages.description: wildlife and yeti sanctuary in Bhutan
pages.extract: Sakteng Wildlife Sanctuary is in Trashigang district of Bhutan.

pages.title: Sekupang
pages.description: district in Batam City, Riau Islands Province, Indonesia
pages.extract: Sekupang is a town and district on the Indonesian island of Batam, in the Riau Islands.  It is primarily known for its domestic ferry terminal, which has extensive services to points west towards Sumatra.

pages.title: Võsu

pages.title: Weslaco (Texas)
pages.description: city in Hidalgo County, Texas, United States
pages.extract: Weslaco is a town in the Rio Grande Valley along the border between Texas and Tamaulipas, Mexico. It is a popular area for birdwatching.

pages.title: Packwood
pages.description: unincorporated community in Washington
pages.extract: Packwood is a mountain town in the Cascades of southwest Washington State. It is close to both Mount Adams and the east side of Mount Rainier, and is the closest town to White Pass.
